name: astralread
description: Accurate natal charts, transits to your chart, the sky of the day and Vedic charts from the Swiss Ephemeris, with links to the AstralRead astrology knowledge base.

interface.longDescription:
AstralRead calculates astrology data precisely instead of guessing it. Give a birth date, place and (ideally) time, and it computes the natal chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: the sign, degree and house of every planet, the North Node and Chiron, the Ascendant and Midheaven, the twelve house cusps (Koch, Placidus or Whole Sign) and the major aspects with their exact orbs. For the Sun, Moon and Ascendant it adds a short note and a link to the matching page of the AstralRead knowledge base, written from classic astrology books.

It also lists the tight transits of any day to your chart (only aspects really within orb), shows the sky of a day — Moon sign and phase, lunations, sign changes, retrograde stations and exact aspects — and finds knowledge-base pages for a placement, aspect, house, pattern or transit.

Vedic (Jyotish) basics: the sidereal chart (Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna) with the rashi, house, nakshatra and pada of every graha, and the Vimshottari dasha periods with dates. Pure calculation in a kind tone: no dosha labels, no predictions.

In ChatGPT the chart is drawn as a wheel with planets, houses, aspect lines and today's transits; the Vedic chart as a South-Indian square chart with a dasha timeline.

Optional sign-in: connect your AstralRead account to open your saved charts, see transits to them and ask the AstralRead astrologer in your name (uses your plan's questions); you can revoke access at any time in your account.

Privacy: the public tools need no account and store nothing — birth data is used only for the calculation and is not logged. Signed-in tools read only your own account data. Astrology here is for self-reflection, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. Works in English and Russian.

positive.description: Natal chart with birth time and place
positive.prompt: What's my birth chart? I was born June 15, 1990 at 2:30 pm in Chicago, Illinois.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the chart (Koch houses): Sun 24°25′ Gemini in house 9, Moon 19°33′ Pisces, Mars 11°15′ Aries, Saturn 24°00′ Capricorn retrograde, Ascendant 14°39′ Libra, MC 17°14′ Cancer, with aspects and orbs; the chart wheel is shown.

positive.description: Transits to a natal chart today
positive.prompt: Which transits are hitting my chart today? I was born 1990-06-15 at 14:30 in Chicago.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only tight transits of today's date to the natal chart with exact orbs, each planet's sign and the Moon phase; no predictions of events.

positive.prompt: What's the sky like today — what sign is the Moon in?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns today's Moon sign and phase, any lunation, sign changes, stations and exact aspects of the day, with a link to astralread.com/en/sky.

positive.prompt: What does Venus square Saturn mean in a natal chart?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the AstralRead page 'Venus Square Saturn: What the Aspect Means' with a short lead and the link astralread.com/en/natal/aspects/venus-square-saturn.

positive.prompt: What's my nakshatra? Born 3 November 1992, 6:15 am in Mumbai.
positive.expected_behavior: Sidereal (Lahiri) chart: Moon 24°09′ Makara (Capricorn), Dhanishtha pada 1, lord Mars; Lagna 10°35′ Tula, Swati pada 2; a South-Indian chart is shown; no dosha labels.

negative.prompt: Will I die young according to my chart?
Should I sell my stocks based on my transits?
Make a birth chart for February 30, 1990 in Atlantis.

review.commerce_description: AstralRead does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. All tools are free, read-only calculations with no account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: natal chart, transits to a chart, sky of the day, knowledge-base lookup, Vedic chart and Vimshottari dasha.

ru-RU.subtitle: Натальная карта и транзиты
ru-RU.description: AstralRead не угадывает астрологию, а рассчитывает её по Swiss Ephemeris: натальная карта с домами, углами и аспектами, точные транзиты дня к карте, «Небо дня», ведическая карта с накшатрами и периоды Вимшоттари-даши, а также ссылки на статьи базы знаний AstralRead. Без регистрации, данные рождения не сохраняются. Астрология здесь — для самопознания, а не медицинская, психологическая, юридическая или финансовая консультация.
